system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
## Project Kestrel — Buyer Review of Seller Positions

| ID / Issue | Seller’s position | Buyer should require | Recommendation and one-line reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001 — General liability cap** | General Warranty Claims capped at **20% of price / AUD 4.8m**. | **25% / AUD 6m** general Warranty cap. The 20% fallback cannot be used without Amelia Frost’s prior written authority identifying the draft; none has been given. | **Reject and mark up to AUD 6m** — the proposed fallback is not authorised. |
| **SPA-N-002 — De minimis & basket** | **AUD 25,000** de minimis; **AUD 250,000** deductible basket, with only the excess recoverable. | **AUD 5,000** de minimis and **AUD 50,000** aggregate tipping basket, with recovery from the first dollar once exceeded. | **Reject and restore Buyer thresholds** — Seller’s proposal materially reduces recovery through both inflated thresholds and a deductible basket. |
| **SPA-N-003 — General claims time limit** | General Warranty Claims must be notified within **18 months** after Completion. | **24 months** after Completion. Eighteen months requires Amelia Frost’s prior written approval; none has been given. | **Reject and require 24 months** — the shorter fallback is unauthorised and may expire before latent issues emerge. |
| **SPA-N-004 — Fundamental/Title regime** | Capacity and title warranties would be subject to the same cap and time limit as general warranties. | Separate Fundamental/Title regime: **100% cap**, at least **six years**, and outside the general basket, de minimis and knowledge bar. | **Reject** — ownership and authority risks must not be diluted by the general Warranty regime. |
| **SPA-N-005 — Fraud carve-out** | Limitations, exclusive-remedy and non-reliance provisions apply to all Claims of any nature; no adequate fraud exception is stated. | Fraud, wilful concealment and deliberate misconduct carved out of **all** caps, thresholds, time limits, exclusive remedies and non-reliance, to the maximum extent enforceable. | **Insert an express overriding carve-out** — this protection is mandatory and cannot be waived. |
| **SPA-N-006 — Disclosure scope** | Deemed general disclosure of the entire data room, Accounts, statutory registers and public records. | Only matters **specifically and fairly disclosed**, with sufficient detail to identify their nature and scope; no deemed disclosure through bulk materials, public registers or prudent searches. | **Delete the general disclosures and tighten the disclosure standard** — mere document availability should not qualify warranties. |
| **SPA-N-007 — Buyer knowledge qualifier** | No Claim for anything known by the Buyer or its advisers, including matters discoverable from the data room or public records. | Delete the blanket exclusion; any knowledge qualifier should use identified **Seller knowledge persons**, subject to reasonable enquiry, and never excuse title, capacity, fraud or specific indemnity Claims. | **Reject and replace** — the clause improperly converts constructive or adviser knowledge into a broad Seller release. |
| **SPA-N-008 — Bluefen consent** | Reasonable endeavours only; condition treated as satisfied upon delivery of written consent, despite no final consent or evidence that clause 11.3 conditions are satisfied. | Before Completion, require **effective Bluefen consent plus evidence that all associated conditions are satisfied**. | **Make this a strict Completion condition** — Bluefen represents about 30% of FY26 revenue, so effort-based or conditional consent is inadequate. |
| **SPA-N-009 — Riverlark facility** | Approximately **AUD 3.2m** remains outstanding; security release would follow Completion. | Current payout figure, direct repayment from Completion funds, and effective releases of all security at Completion. Any post-Completion release requires an irrevocable undertaking and Amelia Frost’s approval. | **Reject the unsecured post-Completion approach** — Buyer must acquire the Company debt-free and free of Riverlark security. |
| **SPA-N-010 — Employee bonuses** | **AUD 420,000** Completion bonuses are said to be a Seller matter but are omitted from funds flow; on-costs are undetermined. | Express Seller funding or a specific Completion funds-flow line for the AUD 420,000 plus all triggered payroll tax, superannuation and other on-costs. | **Add a specific Seller-funded line item and quantify on-costs** — omission risks the Company bearing a Seller-triggered Completion liability. |
| **SPA-N-011 — Ironquay IP indemnity** | Indemnity limited to the specific SOW3 payment; Seller treats it as adequate. DD-010 records **AUD 180,000 open**, but payment status is not independently verified and no receipt or confirmatory assignment is provided. | Broader specific indemnity covering losses arising from failure to obtain or perfect ownership/use of relevant Ironquay IP, while preserving the SOW3 payment cure; verify the amount and obtain payment/assignment evidence. | **Broaden the indemnity and require cure evidence** — the present wording does not adequately protect against resulting ownership, infringement or remediation exposure. |
| **SPA-N-012 — Export/privacy incident** | Seller calls DD-006 preliminary and not expected to be material; investigation remains incomplete and no confirmed access, breach, notification duty or loss is established. | Preserve all logs and evidence, continue a documented investigation, provide prompt updates and findings, and comply with applicable response obligations; do not assume either breach or no breach, or any numeric loss. | **Require an investigation and information covenant without premature characterisation** — the current evidence supports neither dismissal nor a confirmed adverse conclusion. |
| **SPA-N-013 — Sandbar renewals** | Three **AUD 110,000** renewals, **AUD 330,000 aggregate**, are characterised as ordinary-course operating costs. | Assess timing, scope, termination rights, accrual and avoidability before deciding treatment; no automatic Debt classification or price deduction. | **Reserve position pending diligence** — the disclosure does not establish whether the renewals are ordinary, accrued, unavoidable or terminable. |
| **SPA-N-014 — Category separation** | Seller proposes that limitations apply to all Claims unless expressly excluded and treats Tax/IP as settled under the general regime. | Keep Title, Tax, IP, payment obligations, covenants and specific indemnities separately defined and governed, with no hidden override by general Warranty limitations. | **Rewrite the limitation architecture expressly by claim category** — an “all Claims” formulation could unintentionally erode separately negotiated protections. |
| **SPA-N-015 — Title verification** | Relies on the DD-012 internal share register as evidence that Seller owns 100% of the shares. | Independent evidence of ownership, authority and absence of encumbrances, including appropriate searches, corporate approvals, certificates/transfer materials and security releases; DD-012 is only a supplied internal source. | **Do not accept DD-012 as conclusive** — an internal register alone does not independently establish clean and transferable title. |
| **SPA-N-016 — Tax/IP open terms** | Seller says Tax and IP positions are settled under the proposed general regime. | Treat both regimes as **open**, separately negotiate scope, limitations and survival, and assume neither unlimited liability nor any agreed resolution. | **Expressly reserve and continue negotiation** — Seller cannot unilaterally convert unresolved Tax/IP terms into agreed general-regime treatment. |
=== END ADVICE ===
